name: Tabs
description: A sidebar panel with the open tabs, pane by pane, and their tab groups: show, close and drag them from the sidebar, with or without the tab bar (Show tabs in the sidebar makes them vertical tabs). Under them, the tabs your other devices have open, to open here.
